          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "What is Axia?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Axia is an all-in-one business platform that combines CRM, billing, time tracking, and a Truth Layer verification engine. It replaces the five tools freelancers and agencies duct-tape together — one tab, zero chaos."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "Who is Axia built for?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Axia is built for freelancers and agencies — writers, developers, designers, consultants, coaches, photographers, videographers, bookkeepers, marketing agencies, creative agencies, staffing agencies, PR agencies, and digital agencies."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "How does the Truth Layer verification work?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "The Truth Layer is a background engine that validates your activity in real-time. It provides indisputable proof of what was done, when, and for how long — so every billable hour is documented and disputes become a thing of the past."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "How much does Axia cost?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Axia has four plans: Free ($0/mo), Starter ($7/mo), Pro ($15/mo), and Expert ($49/mo). Founding members get 50% off any tier for one year. Every plan includes the Truth Layer verification engine."
          }
        },
        {
          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "What is scope creep protection?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {
            "@type": "Answer",
            "text": "Scope creep protection automatically detects when project work expands beyond the original agreement and creates one-click change orders. This ensures every hour is accounted for and billable — so you never do unpaid work again."
          }
        },

          "@type": "Question",
          "name": "How does the referral program work?",
          "acceptedAnswer": {

          }
        }
      ]
    }
